name: A Ghost in Your Ear
description: When an actor arrives late to a sound studio for a last-minute audiobook recording session, he is handed the script of a chilling ghost story to read. But as the engineer cues the recording and the evening wears on, the horrors slowly begin to escape the page to haunt the studio itself. Fresh from an acclaimed, sold-out run in London, A GHOST IN YOUR EAR is the "truly terrifying headphone horror" (The Guardian) from the darkly brilliant mind of Tony Award® nominee Jamie Armitage (SIX), made in collaboration with Ben and Max Ringham (ANNA, National Theatre). A mesmerizing blend of gothic horror and psychological thriller, this cutting-edge theatrical experience uses groundbreaking binaural sound technology to immerse every audience member in a haunting world of sound. And at Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre - one of New York's most intimate venues - there's no escaping the frights. Enter if you dare.

name: Natalie Brooke & Matt Jalbert Band
description: Natalie Brooke is a rock star. A virtuoso funk / rock keys player leading her powerhouse 4-piece band from the Baltimore area. The explosive act is fronted by Natalie on keys, synth, keytar, and vocals and backed by drummer Nathan Shulkin, Nester on the bass, and Luke Walker on the guitar. She kicks off every show with a punch and never lets the energy drop - audiences move, dance, scream, jump, and ride the wild wave of the set with her and the band. Natalie's music was once said to be a mashup of Rick James and Rush. She has an undeniably infectious vibe featuring a fiery blend of fast tempos and sloshy rock elements balanced with her transcendent jazz and classical roots. Natalie brings an exceptionally unique approach to the keyboard that is equally percussive and melodic that lights up the show with every electrifying note she plays. She is on a meteoric rise, frequently sharing the stage with pillars of the rock, funk, and jazz scenes. Pigeons Playing Ping Pong, Andy Frasco & the UN, Dogs in a Pile, Kanika Moore, Big Something, Cris Jacobs, Doom Flamingo, Sunsquabi, lespecial, and the Magic Beans are a few of the artists Natalie has played with recently. Matt Jalbert Band is the new song-driven project from guitarist and founding member of TAUK. After more than a decade of touring nationally with TAUK---including appearances at Bonnaroo and Hulaween and performances at venues like Red Rocks Amphitheatre---Jalbert steps forward as a lead vocalist and songwriter, bringing a new dimension to his sound. Blending groove-forward indie rock with psychedelic and blues influences, Matt Jalbert Band pairs deep-pocket grooves and adventurous musicianship with concise, melodic, and lyrical songs. The lineup features Matt Jalbert (guitar/vocals), Ben Atkind (drums), Eli Winderman (keys/vocals), Jonathan Colman (bass), and Adam November (guitar). The album, Somebody's Child, arrives November 20, with the title track and first single dropping September 18. Following Jalbert's 2025 instrumental solo release Sauce Buffet, Somebody's Child marks a new chapter---pairing his signature guitar work and groove with vocals, melody, and a more direct emotional voice.

name: Senri Oe Trio
description: Halloween night at Birdland. Expect the unexpected. On the most magical night of the year, something extraordinary is about to happen at New York City's legendary Birdland Theater. The music will cast its own spell --- and once it does, you won't want to break free. Senri Oe Trio takes the stage for two extraordinary nights --- four sets of music that defy category, blur boundaries, and just might bewitch you. Senri Oe is one of the most remarkable reinventions in contemporary music. Beginning classical piano at age three and discovering jazz at fifteen, he first rose to extraordinary heights in Japan: a multi-platinum recording artist, Japanese Grammy winner, actor, television anchor, and author --- a cultural icon whose name defined an era. At forty-seven, at the peak of his fame, Senri made a bold and deeply personal choice. He walked away from stardom, moved to New York City with his beloved dachshund, Peace, and enrolled in The New School for Jazz and Contemporary Music. Under the mentorship of masters including Junior Mance and Aaron Goldberg, he reinvented himself from scratch. It was not a retreat. It was a return to his first love. Since his 2012 jazz debut, Boys Mature Slow, Senri has built a powerful international presence --- performing at the Atlanta and Detroit Jazz Festivals, headlining SummerFest for two consecutive years, and charting at #24 on JazzWeek in 2023 with his album Class of '88. These Birdland performances celebrate the worldwide release of his latest album, HOMEWORK (Global release: September 4, 2026) --- conceived in his Brooklyn living room and recorded at The Bunker Studio with bassist Matt Clohesy and drummer Ross Pederson, with mixing by Aaron Nevezie. HOMEWORK fuses digital and acoustic worlds into a soundtrack without visuals: brilliant, edgy, and profoundly human. Don't miss your chance to be part of something unforgettable. This Halloween, let the music haunt you. Senri Oe --- piano & all compositions Matt Clohesy --- bass Ross Pederson --- drums
why: Pianist Senri Oe's trio on a special Halloween night at Birdland.
